# Draft:Anderson Trucking Service

----
Anderson Trucking Service, Inc. (ATS) is a privately held transportation and logistics company headquartered in St. Cloud, Minnesota. Founded in 1955 by Harold E. Anderson, ATS has grown to become one of the largest for-hire carriers and specialized logistics providers in North America. The company provides a broad range of freight solutions, including vans, flatbed, heavy haul, wind energy transport, warehousing, and multimodal logistics services.
History
As a young man, Harold Anderson drove a truck for Cold Spring Granite. He joined the United States Army Air Forces and served as a captain during World War II. He completed 29 missions as a B24 bomber pilot before his honorable discharge in 1945. Upon returning from the war, he managed the truck fleet at Cold Spring Granite before founding Anderson Trucking Service, Inc. in 1955. The company began with just two drivers, two trucks, and five partial trailers.
Initially, ATS primarily hauled granite, stone, and fabrication equipment. Over the following decades, ATS expanded both its fleet and services, driven by strategic investments and a commitment to specialized freight capabilities. By its 60th anniversary in 2015, ATS had grown into a multi-division operation with dedicated vans, flatbed, heavy haul, and specialized services. During this time, the company also began investing in wind energy transportation, responding to growing market demand and environmental priorities.
Divisions and Affiliates
ATS operates several internal divisions and affiliated entities, including:
* ATS, Inc., focusing on dry van freight
* ATS Specialized and Projects, focusing on oversized and heavy haul cargo and projects
* ATS Logistics Services, Inc., a freight brokerage and third-party logistics company ranked #79 on Transport Topics’ 2025 Top Logistics Companies list.
* ATS International, providing global shipping solutions.
ATS hires company drivers and contracts with independent contractors and owner-operators.
Community Engagement
The Anderson Assistance Foundation (AAF) was established to support employees of the Anderson Family of Companies in times of hardship. As of 2023, AAF had distributed over $1 million in aid to workers in need. ATS is also recognized for its commitment to hiring U.S. military veterans and for its charitable giving within the St. Cloud area.
The Anderson Center, founded in 1998 by Harold and son, Rollie Anderson, provides management and leadership development services in Greater Minnesota.
Facilities and Assets
ATS operates from over 20 locations across the U.S. and location in Bremen, Germany and San Juan, Puerto Rico. The company owns a fleet of more than 4,500 tractors and trailers. In 2025, the company celebrated its 70th anniversary, marking decades of growth and investment in expanded facilities worldwide.
Recognition
* Ranked #31 on the Transport Topics 2024 Top 100 For-Hire Carriers list
* Ranked #33 on Transport Topics 2024 Top LTL carriers
* Ranked #33 on Transport Topics 2024 Top Truckload / Dedicated carriers
* Listed among Inbound Logistics’ Top 100 Truckers
* Named #4 in Transport Topics’ 2024 Top Flatbed/Heavy Specialized Carriers
* Recognized as one of Minnesota’s 100 Largest Private Companies
* Recognized as one of the Twin Cities’ largest logistics companies
* Listed among Transport Topics’ 2025 Top 100 Logistics Companies
* Association of Equipment Manufacturers Member
